deviations.what: t14 additionally adds LOBES_THERMAL_ZONES / LOBES_THERMAL_SHED_C / LOBES_THERMAL_RESUME_C passthroughs to the fleet gateway service's environment: list in lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose.yml (and regenerates tests/goldens/template-defaults.env)
deviations.reason: Found by t13: the gateway service deliberately has no env_file (only scoped keys, compose.yml ~1890), so without explicit passthroughs thermal_c is always None in the container and the thermal shed signal can never be live; no confirmed task owned this compose edit

deviations.what: t15 records host.conditions on the single-model and --all-lobes benchmark results only: 'lobes measure' gets no conditions and 'lobes benchmark --profile' runs inside the window but emits none
deviations.reason: measure's --json is a dict keyed exactly by role (tests/test_cli_measure.py asserts set(payload)==set(ROLES)) and --profile JSON is keyed by profile name; adding a host key breaks both existing JSON contracts, and measure is a short probe, not a load run
